title: The officer sends a QR code
scenario: A caller claiming to be from law enforcement says your identity was used in a financial crime. They tell you to withdraw cash, go to a crypto ATM and scan a QR code to place the money in “federal protection.”

answers.A: Speak with your bank before making any unusual cash withdrawal and explain the caller’s story.
answers.B: Deposit only a small amount first while you verify the case number.
answers.C: End the call and contact the agency through an official published number; do not use the ATM or QR code.

explanation: Government agencies do not secure money by routing it through a crypto wallet controlled by a caller.
proTip: A QR code at a crypto ATM is a destination address, not government protection.
